name: Hands
description: Hands. You can always use them when you have nothing else. Attack speed: 200 RPM

name: Pistol
description: A common pistol. It is handy, but kind of bad  compared to other guns. Fire rate: 200 RPM

name: Axe
description: This viking lookin' axe does a good amout of  damage, but it has a low attack speed. Attack speed: 75 RPM

name: SMG
description: This gun has a pretty high fire rate, and a decent  sized magazine. Fire rate: 750 RPM

name: Bow and arrow
description: The bow is a really unique item. The damage and  speed depends on how much you load it. It takes around 0.7 seconds to fully load.

name: Grenade
description: High explosive warning! The grenade can be thrown, and it'll bounce around for a couple seconds before exploding. Throw speed: 40 RPM

name: Shotgun
description: The only weapon that can fire multiple bullets at once. Recoil and damage is pretty powerful. Fire rate: 60 RPM

name: Sniper
description: Good old bolt action sniper. This gun deals a lot of  damage, but its fire rate is slow. Fire rate: 38 RPM

name: Pet cube
description: Commonly found in the wild under #games Remember to feed them with loves and faves regularly. They are not dangerous, but can be annoying at times.

name: RPG
description: High explosive warning. Shoot this rocket with caution! This gun can only shoot once per reload. Reload speed: 2 sec

name: Shurikens
description: Throwable knife circle thing. A pretty dangerous  weapon that ninjas like to use. Attack speed: 150 RPM

name: Knife
description: It is a knife. Kind of looks like the one from  Robot Destructor but I swear I redrew it. Attack speed: 240 RPM

name: Shield
description: This shield only protect you if you aim it at projectiles. It reduces bullet damages with 50%, and completely  protects you from arrows, throwables and melee weapons.

name: Machinegun
description: This big boi will set back anyone in front of it, with  it's very big magazine and high fire rate. Fire rate: 1400 RPM

name: Assult rifle
description: The m16 assult rifle. An iconic and powerful gun. Fire rate: 668 RPM

name: Heavy pistol
description: This is a pistol with a slow fire rate, small magazine  and pretty high damage. Fire rate: 75 RPM

name: Katana
description: A Samurai's sword, the katana. This weapon can  block throwables and arrows, and it can also attack. Attack speed: 150 RPM

name: Semi-auto rifle
description: The m1 Garand, commonly used in WW 2 by the US.  Also it has a cool iconic "ping" sound. Fire rate: 170 RPM

name: Light SMG
description: This SMG has a ridiculously high fire rate. It has a  small magazine size to compromise the speed. Fire rate: 1500 RPM

name: Taser
description: The only electrical item in the game, this small thing can  deliver a constant spark when it is turned on. Attack speed: constant

name: Medic gun
description: The infamous medic gun. This gun gives health to  others, instead of dealing damage. Fire rate: 150 RPM

name: Medkit
description: A medkit. Since another item can already heal others, there  should be something to heal yourself with, right? Stand still and hold your [use item] button to heal yourself.

name: Nunchaku
description: Another japanese weapon, ey? This item does constant  damage when it has reached a high enough spin velocity. Attack speed: ~1.5 seconds to reach damaging velocity

name: Smoke bomb
description: A grenade that instantly goes off and creates a  smoke cloud for some time. Attack speed: 20 RPM

name: Flamethrower
description: The Boring Company flamethrower. It spews out a big flame that takes damage depending on the smoke. Fire rate: Constant
